description: This bar chart illustrates the task count for different language families, categorized by performance comparison between three models: mBERT, XLM-R, and same, as indicated in the legend. The horizontal axis lists nine language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents task count, ranging from 0 to 40 on a linear scale. Each language family has three stacked bars corresponding to the model comparisons: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and same (light green). The bars are not sorted; they appear in the order listed on the horizontal axis. The approximate values for each bar are as follows: for IE-Baltic, mBERT is around 3, XLM-R is 10, and same is 7; for IE-Germanic, mBERT is 4, XLM-R is 19, and same is 22; for IE-Indic, mBERT is 1, XLM-R is 5, and same is 4; for IE-Romance, mBERT is 4, XLM-R is 13, and same is 30; for IE-Slavic, mBERT is 12, XLM-R is 40, and same is 28; for IE-other, mBERT is 1, XLM-R is 6, and same is 9; for Isolate, mBERT is 1, XLM-R is 5, and same is 1; for Semitic, mBERT is 1, XLM-R is 7, and same is 1; for Uralic, mBERT is 1, XLM-R is 14, and same is 5. The bars are stacked vertically within each language family category, with the mBERT bar at the bottom, the XLM-R bar in the middle, and the same bar on top, visually representing the count of tasks for each comparison. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard presentation.
